---
title: "Main map"
format: 
  html:
    page-layout: full
---


```{r}
#| label: main-map
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| out-height: 80vh
#| out-width: 180vh

library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

dat <- read.csv("intermediates/final_dat.csv", check.names = FALSE)

collection_dat <- dat |> 
  mutate(clickable_link = paste0(
    "<div class='marker-container'><a href='collection.html?", ID, "' target='_blank' class='marker-link'>", 
    ID, "</a><span class='city-tooltip'></span></div>"
  ))

city_dat <- dat |> 
  group_by(City, Country, clong, clat, LID) |> 
  summarise(nice_doi = paste0(DOI, collapse = " <br> "),
            n = length(DOI), 
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(clickable_link = paste0(
    "<div class='marker-container'><a href='city.html?", LID, "' target='_blank' class='marker-link'>", City, ": ", 
    n, "</a><span class='city-tooltip'></span></div>"
  ))

country_dat <- dat |> 
  group_by(Country) |> 
  summarise(n = length(DOI), .groups = "drop") |> 
  inner_join(read.csv("./data/countries.csv")) |> 
  mutate(link = paste0(
    "<div class='marker-container country-zoom' data-lat='", clat, "' data-lng='", clong, "'>", 
    Country, ": ", n, "</div>"
  ))


leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE, minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 12)) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers[["OpenStreetMap.Mapnik"]]) |>
  setView(lng = 15, lat = 55, zoom = 4) |> 
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    data = country_dat,
    lng = ~clong,
    lat = ~clat,
    group = "CountryLevel",
    label = ~lapply(link, htmltools::HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, direction = "center", 
                                textOnly = FALSE, interactive = TRUE, className = "custom-map-label")
  ) |>
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    data = city_dat,
    lng = ~clong,
    lat = ~clat,
    group = "CityLevel",
    label = ~lapply(clickable_link, htmltools::HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, direction = "center", 
                                textOnly = FALSE, interactive = TRUE, className = "custom-map-label")
  ) |>
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    data = collection_dat,
    lng = ~long,
    lat = ~lat,
    group = "CollectionLevel",
    label = ~lapply(clickable_link, htmltools::HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, direction = "center", 
                                textOnly = FALSE, interactive = TRUE, className = "custom-map-label")
  ) |> 
  groupOptions("CountryLevel", zoomLevels = 3L:5) |>
  groupOptions("CityLevel", zoomLevels = 6L:9) |> 
  groupOptions("CollectionLevel", zoomLevels = 10L:12) |> 
  addEasyButtonBar(
    easyButton(
      icon = htmltools::HTML("<span>Country</span>"),
      title = "Zoom to Country Level",
      onClick = JS("function(btn, map) { map.setZoom(4); }")
    ),
    easyButton(
      icon = htmltools::HTML("<span>City</span>"),
      title = "Zoom to City Level",
      onClick = JS("function(btn, map) { map.setZoom(6); }")
    ),
    easyButton(
      icon = htmltools::HTML("<span>Collection</span>"),
      title = "Zoom to Collection Level",
      onClick = JS("function(btn, map) { map.setZoom(10); }")
    )
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this; 
      
      var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      var targetLat = urlParams.get('lat');
      var targetLng = urlParams.get('lng');
      
      if (targetLat && targetLng) {
        map.setView([parseFloat(targetLat), parseFloat(targetLng)], 11);
      }
      
      el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        
        var marker = e.target.closest('.country-zoom');
        
        if (marker) {
          e.preventDefault(); 
          e.stopPropagation();
          
          var lat = parseFloat(marker.getAttribute('data-lat'));
          var lng = parseFloat(marker.getAttribute('data-lng'));
          
          map.setView([lat, lng], 6);
        }
      }, true); 
    }
  ")

```
